title: In an abstract group, the operation cancels on the left
statement: For any group record G (an abstract carrier, binary op, identity e, inverse, associativity, two-sided identity and inverse laws) and elements a b c of G's carrier, if op a b = op a c then b = c.

formal.statement: theorem Alg.mul_left_cancel : ((x0 : Alg.Group) -> ((x1 : Alg.Group.carrier x0) -> ((x2 : Alg.Group.carrier x0) -> ((x3 : Alg.Group.carrier x0) -> ((x4 : Eq.{1} (Alg.Group.carrier x0) (Alg.Group.op x0 x1 x2) (Alg.Group.op x0 x1 x3)) -> Eq.{1} (Alg.Group.carrier x0) x2 x3)))))

evidence.supports: Alg.mul_left_cancel admits through the trusted kernel gate. Instantiated CONCRETELY at Int.addGroup (a := 2, b := 3, c := 3, hypothesis Eq.refl of `2+3`) with the type checked to reduce to Eq 3 3, and SYMBOLICALLY at both Int.addGroup and Rat.addGroup, closed over free a b c and the hypothesis fvar -- the chain b = e*b = (a'*a)*b = a'*(a*b) = a'*(a*c) = (a'*a)*c = e*c = c (a' := inv a) specializes and every selector application iota-reduces through both instances.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib -- mul_left_cancel_applies_concretely_and_symbolically --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out"| grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: Anchored on cargo's own pass/fail summary line with both counts pinned, so any TypeMismatch or assertion failure changes the pattern.

evidence.supports: Alg.mul_left_cancel instantiated at Int.addGroup (op := Int.add) has the SAME TYPE as the hand-proved Int.add_left_cancel -- a genuine retirement candidate under ADR-1581's rule (a hand proof's citations are necessary, not sufficient: retirement additionally needs Int.add_left_cancel to not be cited by anything declared before this theorem's position in the build sequence, which this lane did not audit).
evidence.checker_command: out=$(cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib -- retirement_int_add_left_cancel --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out"| grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1

provenance.established_by: axeyum-lean-kernel build_rat_prelude, lane structures-2, ADR-1584 -- proved once over the abstract Alg.Group record and instantiated at two independently-built carriers.

notes: A genuine retirement candidate for Int.add_left_cancel (same type, at the additive group). NOT a retirement candidate for anything named `Nat.mul_left_cancel`: Nat's multiplicative monoid has no two-sided inverse (Nat.mul_left_cancel_of_pos is the CONDITIONAL, non-group shape this theorem does not generalize -- grepped and confirmed absent under the exact name).
